oidcc-prompt-login.REVIEW: The suite keeps a screenshot of the second sign-in page, which `prompt=login` must show, for a person to look at. The test passes otherwise.

oidcc-max-age-1.REVIEW: The suite keeps a screenshot of the second sign-in page, which `max_age=1` must show, for a person to look at. The test passes otherwise.

oidcc-ensure-registered-redirect-uri.REVIEW: Hodor shows its own error page and never sends the browser to an address that is not registered; the suite keeps a screenshot of that page for a person to look at.

oidcc-claims-essential.WARNING: It asks for `name` through the `claims` parameter only. Hodor does not read that parameter, and discovery says so (`claims_parameter_supported` is false), so UserInfo gives the claims of the scopes, here only `sub`; supporting the parameter is optional (OpenID Connect Core, section 5.5).
